note:
Round 1 of the mouth corner and chin variant of the three clinical-result blocks on /pages/acetyl-hexapeptide-8-research - templates/page.research-argireline.json, section `key_findings`, blocks f1, f2, f3. Malcolm, 2026-08-25: alongside the crow's-feet set (r2), a full batch on mouth corner and chin so the three blocks need not all be near-identical eye macros stacked down one page.

⚠️ SITE-OF-MEASUREMENT CAVEAT, RECORDED BECAUSE IT AFFECTS WHAT THE PICTURE CLAIMS. All three of these trials measured the PERIORBITAL region: Wang 2013 applied to the crow's-feet area, Blanes-Mira 2002's in-use test was around the eyes, An 2019 was a periorbital split-face study. A mouth corner and chin frame therefore shows a DIFFERENT SITE from the one the figure was measured at. The page's own body copy says the peptide is valued for expression lines "around the eyes and forehead", so a forehead frame is defensible as a general expression-line illustration; the mouth and chin set is the furthest from what was measured. This is Malcolm's call, made with the caveat stated on 2026-08-25. If any of these ship, the block copy or alt text should not imply the figure was measured at the site shown.

INHERITED UNCHANGED FROM r2, AND ALL OF IT IS LOAD-BEARING:
  * CAUCASIAN MIDDLE-AGED WOMEN, three visibly different individuals across the three blocks - different age within middle age, different eye and hair colour, different skin character - so one woman never appears enrolled in three studies on one page.
  * THE DIPTYCH. Two panels of exactly equal width meeting at a crisp central edge. All 33 r1 candidates landed the seam within 0.5% of centre, so this works on every engine. The matrixyl brief's ban on split frames does not apply here and its `no split screen` negatives stay removed.
  * NO LETTERING FROM ANY ENGINE. Every percentage is composited afterwards by scripts/label-before-after.py from the `label` block. MATRIXYL failed in ~30 of 50 candidates on this project and a correct PDRN was resampled into PORN; a garbled efficacy figure is a false clinical claim on a live storefront.
  * THE HONESTY DEVICE: the number and position of the creases is IDENTICAL in both halves and NO CREASE MAY DISAPPEAR. Only depth and shadow change. Every mole, freckle, pore and stray hair stays exactly where it is. This is also what the studies measured - roughness and depth, not line count.
  * MAGNITUDE AS A FRACTION OF DEPTH, so it is checkable rather than a matter of taste: f1 about half, f2 about a third, f3 the smallest but still plainly visible when the halves are compared.
  * SKIN REALISM, SPECIFIED POSITIVELY. r1 failed three ways: white specular flecks reading as flaking (caused by the words sheen/glow/hydrated, all now banned), Seedream painting wrinkles on as literal slash marks (caused by describing lines as marks placed on skin rather than as the skin being creased), and uniform machine texture. So: pore size varying BY ZONE, individual outsized pores, asymmetric freckling, capillary flush, matte-to-oily variation.

COLOUR: Acetyl's scene colour is Pearl grey D8D6D4, as the GROUND behind the skin, never a cast on it.

CLASS B, no references. Square 2048x2048.

MOUTH CORNER AND CHIN-SPECIFIC GEOMETRY, AND A CLAIM CONSTRAINT. The creases here run vertically and diagonally, which suits a vertical split - they will not bridge the divider the way forehead lines can. But NOT EVERY LINE IN THIS REGION IS AN EXPRESSION LINE: the nasolabial fold and the marionette line are substantially volume loss and facial descent, which this peptide does not address. What Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 is studied for is EXPRESSION lines - so these frames show the fine vertical perioral creases at and above the corner of the mouth and the puckered mentalis texture of the chin, and the prompts explicitly keep the deep nasolabial fold out of frame or unchanged.
labels_are_composited: scripts/label-before-after.py - see `label` on each slot. The engines never draw text.

slots.title: f1 · Wang 2013 — 48.9% anti-wrinkle efficacy vs 0% placebo, 4 weeks  —  mouth corner and chin
slots.prompt:
An unretouched clinical dermatology reference photograph, filling the entire square frame edge to edge, divided into TWO PANELS OF EXACTLY EQUAL WIDTH that meet at one crisp vertical edge precisely at the centre.

BOTH PANELS SHOW THE SAME WOMAN, THE SAME PART OF HER FACE, FROM AN IDENTICAL CAMERA POSITION WITH IDENTICAL LIGHTING. Same face, same brow shape, same freckles and moles in exactly the same places. The camera has not moved between the two panels and the light has not changed. NOTHING DIFFERS BETWEEN THE PANELS EXCEPT THE DEPTH OF THE CREASES IN THE SKIN.

She is a white European woman of about fifty-two, with fair skin, blue-grey eyes and light brown hair drawn back off her face. She wears no makeup at all. The framing is a tight macro of THE CORNER OF HER MOUTH AND THE CHIN BELOW IT: the outer end of the lips, the skin immediately above and around the mouth corner, and the front of the chin. No eyes, no nose, no hairline, no ear. The mouth is closed and completely relaxed - she is not smiling, not pursing her lips and not clenching.

The deep nasolabial fold running from the nose is kept OUT OF FRAME - it is largely volume loss and facial descent, which this peptide does not address, and including it would imply a claim the studies do not support. The creases shown are expression creases: fine vertical lines in the skin above and beside the mouth corner, and the fine puckered dimpling of the chin.

THE SKIN IS THE SUBJECT AND IT MUST BE REAL. Pores vary in size and in density across the frame - noticeably larger and more open toward the centre of the face, finer and tighter out at the edge - with two or three individual pores clearly larger than their neighbours. Sun-freckling is scattered and asymmetric, with one small raised brown mole. A faint diffuse capillary flush warms the skin. Fine pale vellus hairs catch the light, lying in different directions. The skin is slightly oily and light-catching in one area and completely matte in another. This is a documentary photograph of a real face, not a beauty campaign.

In the LEFT panel, the skin above and beside the corner of the mouth is drawn into five or six fine vertical creases, each folded deeply enough to hold a distinct shadow, and the chin below carries a fine puckered dimpling like the skin of an orange.

In the RIGHT panel, THE SAME FIVE OR SIX CREASES ARE STILL THERE, IN THE SAME PLACES AND THE SAME NUMBER, AND NOT ONE HAS DISAPPEARED. Each is about half as deep - the fold softer, the shadow much lighter, the edges less sharply defined - and the chin dimpling is shallower. The deepest crease is still plainly visible. Every freckle, mole, pore and stray hair is exactly where it was.

One soft directional key light from the upper left with a gentle fill, raking just enough across the surface to describe the relief of the skin. The background behind her, thrown softly out of focus, is a smooth pale pearl grey, colour hex D8D6D4. Shot on a 100mm macro lens, sharp, honest and completely unretouched.
